_meta.purpose: VL-F-10 ANNUAL-INSTRUMENT registry — a small, lawyer-reviewable seed of Czech legal instrument FAMILIES that are REISSUED on a periodic (annual) cadence. Each family names the LATEST known instrument (external_id + its valid_to = the expected-reissue horizon) and the cadence. Consumed by pythia/monitoring/annual_check.py::run_annual_check to ALERT when the latest instrument has expired AND no successor was ingested into the live corpus (silent staleness). PURE data; no code. Small + clearly a SEED — expand under lawyer review.
_meta.status: DRAFT SEED — LAWYER/OPERATOR REVIEW before expanding beyond the seeded families.
_meta.valid_to_semantics: CRITICAL: an annual instrument's valid_to is an EXPECTED-REISSUE horizon, NOT a repeal date. A naive daily job keying off taxonomy._temporal_status(valid_to <= today => REPEALED) would FALSELY stamp these families REPEALED the day after valid_to. run_annual_check NEVER auto-marks REPEALED; it only ALERTS when there is a POSITIVE no-successor finding in the supplied corpus rows (fail-open on unknowns). See the module docstring's 'VL-F-10 AUDIT' block.

families.description: Cestovní náhrady / travel allowances — MPSV vyhláška reissued annually (diet rates «stravné», per-km rates «sazba základní náhrady», fuel prices). The live seeded example.
families.successor_hint: Expect a new MPSV vyhláška o změně sazeb ... cestovních náhrad for the following year (e.g. a 20xx/20xx external_id).

families.description: Minimum-wage nařízení vlády — coefficients / guaranteed-wage tiers set by NV, adjusted (typically) annually.
families.successor_hint: Expect a new NV o výši minimální mzdy a nejnižších úrovní zaručené mzdy for the following year.

families.description: Stravné-derived meal-allowance / stravenkový paušál upper limit — pinned to the annually-reissued travel-allowance diet rate, so its practical figure goes stale on the same cadence.
families.successor_hint: Tracks the cestovni-nahrady family's successor vyhláška for the following year.
